commands.formal: PYTHONPATH=src python demo.py --continuous-source-field --bunny-mesh data/stanford_bunny/cache/bun_zipper.ply --bunny-artifacts artifacts --bunny-figures figures --render-output render_res

emission_factor: 1-exp(-(max(0,n dot omega)/0.05)^2); no packet identity deletion
limitations: the volume-shell source measure is algorithmic, not calibrated physical radiometry
finite Sobol anchors retain integration variance at very narrow widths
one-step projection is continuous but not an exact root solve
compact-support culling skips exact zero terms only and does not alter latent identity
no optimization or birth result is reported unless all prerequisite gates pass
non_sdf_coordinate: d_F=F/sqrt(||grad F||^2+eta^2), eta=1e-6 median anchor ||grad F||
projection: x_tilde=a-F(a)gradF(a)/(||gradF(a)||^2+eta^2); exactly one step; no convergence branch
scope: fixed latent continuous zero-set source experiment; no novelty or physical-radiometry claim
source_energy: E_source=w_j(F) C(x_tilde_j) emission_factor_j [0.35+0.65 max(0,n dot omega)]

source_energy_linearity.scope: linear in source/transported energy for fixed geometry; nonlinear in geometry

source_measure.kernel_regularness: compact C2; value, first derivative, and second derivative vanish at support boundary
source_measure.measure_semantics: algorithmic normalized volume-shell measure; asymptotically coarea-like near regular zero sets, not claimed as physical radiometry
source_measure.reference_area_rule: initial-field N=32768 global Sobol estimate at epsilon_s/h_s=1, computed once and frozen
